findings.issue: An ambient $AUDIT_GATE_TASK silently becomes the task for any direct `audit-status.py --gate` run (CI step, release check, a human's shell with the variable exported), so a sign-off-shaped run can exempt bugs while the task text says 'no task'. It is printed ('named by $AUDIT_GATE_TASK ...'), so it is visible, but the task description asked for an explicit argument the gate step passes and for sign-off and the release guard to keep counting every open high bug. run-test-gate clears the variable for its own no-task runs, so that path is safe; a direct invocation is not covered by any case.
findings.resolution: Either keep the env channel and add a case that a direct no-task run under an exported variable is reported loudly (it is, by the 'GATE TASK' line) and not read by CI/sign-off callers, or have run-test-gate also pass --task where the plan's gate command is an audit-status call. At minimum document the variable beside --task in commands/status.md.

findings.issue: For a task id the plan does not hold (gate_exemptions returns {}), _exemption_lines prints 'no open high bug is exempted - none is linked to this task or to an open task of its phase', which implies the task exists. gx9 checks the facts function but not this output.
findings.resolution: When the task is not in the plan, say 'task X is not in the plan, so nothing is exempted', and pin it in gx9.

findings.issue: A new public flag --task and an environment variable are added to audit-status.py with no mention in commands/status.md or the changelog; the executor flagged this itself and left it out because the task names no docs.
findings.resolution: Add a line for --task / $AUDIT_GATE_TASK to commands/status.md and a changelog entry in this phase's release notes.

preExisting.issue: The no-change close builds the same both-ends bug set inline, a third copy of what _status_facts.task_bug_ids now defines; the executor left it as outside its files.
preExisting.resolution: Point it at _status_facts.task_bug_ids in a later task.

'exempt, for open-high-bugs only, the bugs linked to that task and to the other still-open tasks of the same phase' - gate_exemptions covers the task plus non-TERMINAL siblings, effective_bug_status not in CLOSED_BUG, high only, and evaluate_gate reads exempt in the open-high-bugs arm alone (gx8).
